title: Definitions in other locations within this title
text:
19.50.020 Definitions in other locations within this title.
For the purpose of this title, certain terms and words are to be used and interpreted as defined within the articles or sections of this title wherein they apply to certain regulations. These sections include but are not limited to "subdivision ordinance, dormant projects," specifically within section 19.47.080.
(Ord. 16882 § 2(part), 2008)
(Ord. No. 17236, § 24, 11-10-2009)
